message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on a Halloween costume. Costumes for carnival or festive use fall under heading 9505 if they are festive articles. Under Note 1(e) to Chapter 61 and Chapter 62, garments of a kind commonly worn as costumes are excluded when they're not of textile construction. The usual ruling is that a costume of textile materials made up of a coat, hat, and so on is classified in 9505.90.60 as festive articles. Costumes sold as sets with masks and latex pieces are generally classified in 9505.90.6000, "Other: Other." Before 2007 or so, the costume rulings placed adult costumes in chapters 61/62 if they were of substantial construction, but the typical ruling for this set is 9505.90.6000 because the garments are not of a kind commonly worn as ordinary apparel and are of flimsy construction. I'm going with 9505.90.6000.
